frame: body axes from the model's origin (the empty CG): x forward, y right, z down; m, kg

basis.limits: the design's flight control envelope (its structure's limits)
basis.strength: the design's ultimate load (1.5 x the flight control's n limits) at its design mass, flown symmetrically; tails and nose by the same rule (estimate)
basis.skin_mass_source: SKIN_SHARE of kind=structure spatial quadrature only; engines, systems, gear and items excluded; rigid mass moments unchanged
basis.shares: hangar's strip model: dN/dalpha and dY/dbeta per section

mass_partition.objective: minimum relative entropy, each item mass and declared full moments constrained
mass_partition.mounted_weights: engine, gear and authored item quadrature weights fixed
mass_partition.distribution_uncertainty: Inferred, nonunique engineering spatial distribution on declared geometry support; not measured section density
